articles.title: Leilão Vila COP 30: Pará leiloa camas, cofres e 405 lotes de itens | G1
articles.standfirst: Leilão será on-line em 4 de dezembro, com participação de pessoas físicas e jurídicas. Interessados poderão visitar os bens em Belém, Ananindeua e Marituba antes de fazer os lances.
articles.summary: O leilão da Vila COP 30 oferece 405 lotes de móveis e utensílios, como camas e cofres, com lances on-line no dia 4 de dezembro para pessoas físicas e jurídicas.
articles.body:
Vila COP 30 — Foto: Carlos Tavares/Agência Pará

Camas box, travesseiros, edredons, cofres e secadores de cabelo estão entre os itens da antiga Vila COP 30 que serão leiloados pelo governo do Pará. Ao todo, serão ofertados 405 lotes, em um leilão exclusivamente pela internet, no dia 4 de dezembro , a partir das 10h.

Pessoas físicas e jurídicas do Pará e de outros estados poderão participar. Os lotes serão vendidos a quem oferecer o maior lance.

O edital foi publicado nesta quinta-feira (12) pela Secretaria de Estado de Planejamento e Administração (Seplad), em parceria com a Secretaria de Estado de Turismo (Setur), no Diário Oficial do Estado.

“Estamos dando uma nova destinação aos bens móveis e utensílios que fizeram parte da estrutura da Vila COP”, afirmou a secretária-adjunta de Modernização e Gestão Administrativa da Seplad, Áurea Pinheiro.

A antiga Vila COP 30 funciona atualmente como centro administrativo do governo estadual.

Os 405 lotes reúnem móveis e utensílios utilizados na estrutura da Vila COP. Entre eles estão:

Itens da antiga Vila COP 30 vão a leilão no Pará. — Foto: Marco Santos / Agência Pará

Os interessados deverão fazer o credenciamento prévio no site de leilões e acessar a plataforma com login e senha.

A disputa será realizada em 4 de dezembro de 2026, a partir das 10h, pelo critério de maior lance ofertado.

A visitação será permitida de 1º a 3 de dezembro, em horário comercial. Nesse período, os interessados poderão conferir as condições físicas e de conservação dos bens antes de apresentar os lances.

Os itens estão distribuídos em três endereços na Região Metropolitana de Belém :

Ananindeua: Rua Governador Magalhães Barata, nº 102, Canal do Ariri;

Marituba: Rua Juscelino Kubitschek, nº 4765, Centro;

Belém: Avenida Brigadeiro Protásio, nº 621, bairro do Marco.

Os bens serão vendidos no estado físico e de conservação em que se encontram. Eventuais reparos, defeitos ou ausência de componentes ficarão sob responsabilidade dos compradores .

Após a aquisição e o pagamento, os compradores terão cinco dias úteis para retirar todos os itens dos lotes adquiridos. A contagem começa na emissão da Nota de Venda em Leilão, e o prazo não poderá ser prorrogado.

Os custos e os riscos da retirada também serão de responsabilidade dos compradores.

Mais informações sobre os lotes, as condições de conservação dos bens e o edital do leilão poderão ser consultadas no site .

Os interessados também poderão entrar em contato com a Diretoria de Gestão do Patrimônio do Estado (DGP) da Seplad, localizada na Travessa do Chaco, nº 2350, bairro do Marco, em Belém, pelo telefone (91) 3251-2907 ou pelo e-mail cpam.dgp@seplad.pa.gov.br.

articles.title: Câmara do Rio aprova 362 homenagens com votações de segundos | G1
articles.standfirst: Cada vereador pode conceder até 18 honrarias por ano. Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga a deputada eleita em SP que se diz 'inimiga das feministas' provovou polêmica.
articles.summary: A Câmara do Rio aprovou 362 homenagens em 2026 com votações rápidas e gastos de R$ 70 mil, gerando polêmica pela entrega de medalhas a aliados e parentes de políticos.
articles.body:
A Câmara Municipal do Rio de Janeiro aprovou 362 homenagens desde o início de 2026 . O número equivale a mais de uma concessão por dia. Apesar do volume de honrarias, a população não encontra as propostas na Ordem do Dia, a pauta tradicional das sessões legislativas, segundo levantamento da reportagem.

As indicações chegam aos gabinetes dos vereadores na véspera das votações. Em muitos casos, a aprovação acontece em poucos segundos , por aclamação, sem registro de votos individuais.

A Câmara, por outro lado, afirma que os requerimentos são publicados no site da instituição e no Diário Oficial. Segundo a Casa, depois da publicação, a apreciação ocorre na sessão ordinária seguinte, respeitando o prazo previsto no Regimento Interno.

As homenagens são entregues em cerimônias públicas, muitas vezes com festa e participação dos homenageados. A personal trainer Carol Vaz, conhecida nas redes sociais, por exemplo, foi uma das personalidades agraciadas. Ela recebeu uma homenagem da Câmara há cinco anos e voltou a ser reconhecida em 2024.

A tramitação das propostas, no entanto, é menos conhecida do público.

Um dos casos de aprovações que provocaram reação dentro e fora da Câmara aconteceu nesta semana, com a aprovação da Medalha de Reconhecimento Chiquinha Gonzaga para a deputada estadual eleita por São Paulo Eduarda Campopiano (PL).

A proposta foi apresentada pelos vereadores Fernando Armelau e Alana Passos, do PL; Marcos Dias, do Podemos; e Leniel Borel, do Progressistas.

A votação ocorreu por aclamação, um procedimento em que os vereadores que concordam com a proposta permanecem como estão. O presidente anuncia a aprovação sem que haja uma votação nominal.

Campopiano se apresenta nas redes sociais como a maior inimiga das feministas e já fez declarações negando a existência do feminicídio. A concessão da medalha provocou questionamentos sobre a compatibilidade da homenagem com os critérios previstos no Regimento Interno da Câmara.

O Instituto dos Advogados Brasileiros (IAB) apresentou uma representação pedindo a revisão da concessão. Para a entidade, negar a existência do feminicídio não representa atuação em prol de uma causa humanitária, mas o oposto.

O artigo 319 do Regimento Interno estabelece que a Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga é destinada a personalidades femininas que tenham se destacado em causas democráticas, humanitárias, artísticas e culturais.

O regulamento também sugere que a entrega aconteça no Dia Internacional da Mulher, em 8 de março. A data tem relação com a trajetória da compositora e abolicionista que dá nome à honraria.

A Câmara informou que não recebeu representação da OAB-RJ sobre o caso. Também não quis se pronunciar sobre o pedido apresentado na Casa para cancelar a homenagem.

A Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga é apenas uma das honrarias que os vereadores podem conceder. Cada parlamentar tem direito a distribuir diferentes tipos de reconhecimento ao longo do ano.

Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga: até três por vereador, destinada a personalidades femininas;

Medalha São Francisco de Assis: até cinco por vereador, para pessoas que atuam na defesa dos animais;

Título de Mérito Esportivo Hélio Gracie: um por vereador;

Placa de Reconhecimento do Servidor Público Municipal: uma por vereador;

Título de Cidadão Carioca: até três por vereador;

Medalha de Mérito Pedro Ernesto: até cinco por vereador.

Somadas, as cotas permitem que cada vereador conceda até 18 homenagens por ano. Considerando os 51 parlamentares da Casa, o potencial chega a 918 concessões anuais.

Se distribuídas ao longo de todos os dias do ano, seriam aproximadamente duas homenagens e meia por dia.

Cada medalha custa pouco mais de R$ 100. Considerando o volume de condecorações, o gasto anual com a confecção das peças pode chegar a aproximadamente R$ 70 mil.

Parte das honrarias concedidas pela Câmara acaba destinada a integrantes da própria classe política. Entre os homenageados deste ano estão o deputado federal André Janones (Rede), a vice na chapa de Eduardo Paes, Jane Reis (MDB), e o governador em exercício do Rio, Ricardo Couto.

Outro exemplo é o deputado federal eleito por São Paulo Lucas Pavanato (PL), que recebeu a Medalha de Mérito Pedro Ernesto.

O levantamento também identificou 12 vereadores homenageados em um intervalo de dois anos. Marcelo Diniz (PSD) recebeu três honrarias. Outros parlamentares receberam uma cada: Carlo Caiado, Cesar Maia, Carlos Bolsonaro, Rafael Satiê, Rick Azevedo, Leniel Borel, Leonel de Esquerda, Joyce Trindade e Marcio Ribeiro.

As homenagens também aparecem entre familiares de parlamentares.

O vereador Poubel concedeu honrarias aos irmãos Glauber Poubel e Filipe Poubel, deputado estadual. Helena Vieira homenageou o irmão, Luciano Vieira. Já Rogério Amorim concedeu uma medalha ao irmão, Rodrigo Amorim.

A Medalha de Mérito Pedro Ernesto é considerada a principal honraria da Câmara Municipal do Rio. O prêmio leva o nome do médico e político que governou o então Distrito Federal entre 1931 e 1936 e ficou conhecido por obras na área de educação e saúde.

Em resposta à reportagem, a Câmara Municipal do Rio afirmou que os requerimentos para concessão de medalhas são publicados no site da instituição e no Diário Oficial.

Segundo a Casa, após a publicação no Diário Oficial, a apreciação ocorre na sessão ordinária seguinte, garantindo a transparência do processo.

A Câmara citou o artigo 320 do Regimento Interno, que determina que a indicação das personalidades escolhidas para receber comendas legislativas seja submetida ao plenário após publicação prévia no Diário da Câmara Municipal, com pelo menos um dia de antecedência.

articles.title: Ao suspender voos nos EUA, governo descarta ataque: 'Não é novo 11/9' | G1
articles.standfirst: Agência determinou que voos que partem de aeroportos americanos permaneçam em solo até segunda ordem. Markwayne Mullin disse que problema é de telecomunicação.
articles.summary: A suspensão de voos nos EUA foi causada por uma falha nas telecomunicações que afetou 7 mil viagens; o governo e a FAA descartam a hipótese de ataque externo.
articles.body:
O secretário de Segurança Interna dos EUA, Markwayne Mullin, disse que a suspensão de todas as decolagens em todos os aeroportos do país nesta sexta-feira (13) se deu por um "problema de telecomunicação" e descartou um possível ataque.

Segundo a Administração Federal de Aviação do país (FAA, na sigla em inglês), a medida foi adotada por circunstâncias extraordinárias e motivos de segurança. A orientação é que todos os voos com partida prevista nos Estados Unidos permaneçam em solo até novo aviso.

Em entrevista na Casa Branca, Mullin afirmou que "não há motivos" para preocupação com um possível ataque.

"Até agora, não há sinal de que se trate de um ataque contra nós. Trata-se, por ora, apenas de uma falha nas telecomunicações. Isso levará algum tempo para ser resolvido", disse.

"Quero reforçar: não há motivo para o público ficar com medo ou preocupado com seus familiares. Isso não é um novo 11 de setembro. O que ocorre agora é uma falha nas telecomunicações. É algo bem diferente."

O secretário de Segurança Interna dos EUA, Markwayne Mullin — Foto: Elizabeth Frantz/Reuters

Questionado sobre se o caso poderia ter alguma relação com inteligência artificial, o secretário afirmou que na Casa Branca o termo usado é "Superinteligência" e que as investigações sobre o ocorrido seguem.

"Não podemos descartar nada nesse momento. Nós vamos seguir investigando o que aconteceu e, quando descobrirmos, vamos tomar as ações necessárias para que não aconteça novamente."

A suspensão foi anunciada depois que a FAA interrompeu o tráfego aéreo em Chicago devido a problemas de comunicação entre os controladores de voo.

Segundo a agência, os voos internacionais com destino aos Estados Unidos serão avaliados individualmente.

De acordo com dados do site de monitoramento FlightAware, quase 7 mil voos nos Estados Unidos foram atrasados ou cancelados em consequência da suspensão nacional.

Um avião pousa após a Administração Federal de Aviação dos EUA (FAA) emitir uma ordem nacional de suspensão de voos em solo "devido a circunstâncias extraordinárias e razões de segurança". Aeroporto Nacional Ronald Reagan de Washington , em Arlington, Virgínia, EUA — Foto: REUTERS/Jonathan Ernst

A TV Globo apurou com uma fonte que trabalha em uma torre de controle de um aeroporto de Nova York que o problema está relacionado a um cruzamento de frequências de rádio.

Com isso, mais de uma aeronave consegue transmitir mensagens ao mesmo tempo na mesma frequência, o que dificulta a comunicação com os controladores.

Na prática, os profissionais não conseguem identificar com clareza qual avião está falando com a torre.

A previsão inicial era que a restrição durasse até as 22h UTC (19h no horário de Brasília).

A suspensão de todas as decolagens nos Estados Unidos tem precedente recente: em janeiro de 2023, a FAA adotou a mesma medida .

articles.title: Rio Barra Mansa: Defesa Civil em alerta após chuva forte na região | G1
articles.standfirst: Moradores de seis bairros devem ficar atentos à possibilidade de elevação do nível do rio. Alerta foi enviado também para Rio Claro, Volta Redonda e Pinheiral.
articles.summary: A Defesa Civil monitora o Rio Barra Mansa e orienta atenção redobrada nos bairros Nova Esperança e Boa Sorte após alerta de chuva forte emitido nesta sexta-feira.
articles.body:
Prefeitura de Barra Mansa — Foto: Divulgação/Prefeitura de Barra Mansa

A Defesa Civil de Barra Mansa (RJ) intensificou o monitoramento da bacia do Rio Barra Mansa após um alerta de chuva emitido pela Defesa Civil Estadual por volta das 17h25 desta sexta-feira (13). A mensagem foi enviada pelo sistema Cell Broadcast para Barra Mansa (RJ), Rio Claro (RJ), Volta Redonda (RJ) e Pinheiral (RJ).

Segundo o coordenador municipal da Defesa Civil, João Vitor, um núcleo de chuva intensa entre Barra Mansa e Rio Claro pode provocar uma elevação do nível do Rio Barra Mansa.

As equipes redobraram a atenção sobre a bacia. A orientação é que moradores próximos ao rio, principalmente nos bairros Nova Esperança, São Luís, Boa Sorte, Piteiras, Santa Clara e Jardim Marajoara, fiquem atentos.

Ainda segundo o coordenador, qualquer alteração será comunicada à população.

articles.title: Piloto informa os passageiros sobre a paralisação de voos nos EUA | G1
articles.standfirst: Todos os aeroportos do país estão com atividades paradas por motivos de segurança após um problema de comunicação que afeta os centros de controle de tráfego aéreo.
articles.summary: Todos os aeroportos do país estão com atividades paradas por motivos de segurança após um problema de comunicação que afeta os centros de controle de tráfego aéreo.
articles.body:
Um vídeo gravado por passageiros nesta sexta-feira (13) mostra o momento em que piloto comunica a quem está a bordo sobre a paralisação dos voos nos Estados Unidos . Todos os aeroportos do país estão com atividades paradas por motivos de segurança após um problema de comunicação nos centros de controle de tráfego aéreo.

No aviso, o piloto pede desculpas às pessoas e diz não ter informações sobre o motivo do problema. As imagens foram feitas pelo cinegrafista da TV Globo Victor Albuquerque no Aeroporto de Los Angeles.

"Temos informações muito limitadas aqui, mas, pelo que entendi, controladores de tráfego aéreo estão pedindo para os aviões pousarem", disse o piloto. "Isso não acontecia, todos se lembram, há mais de 20 anos. Algo está acontecendo e, francamente, não sabemos o que", afirmou, ao se referir ao 11 de Setembro.

O profissional continua a explicação aos passageiros ao dizer que eles "tiveram sorte" de não decolarem pois, caso tivessem no ar, "teríamos que dar meia-volta".

Outros vídeos feitos em diferentes voos mostram como os passageiros reagiram aos alertas emitidos pelas tripulações impedidas de voar. Uma mulher afirma estar dentro do avião no aeroporto de Fort Lauderdale, na Flórida.

"Estávamos prestes a decolar quando o piloto falou: 'Não podemos decolar. Todos os voos foram suspensos", afirmou.

Passageiros em aviões durante paralisção nos EUA — Foto: Reprodução/Tiktok

Outro homem em um voo que sairia do aeroporto de Palm Beach, também na Flórida, também registrou a suspensão. "Nosso avião estava prestes a decolar, mas parou", afirmou.

A Administração Federal de Aviação dos Estados Unidos (FAA, na sigla em inglês) determinou nesta sexta-feira (13) a suspensão de todas as decolagens no país após um problema de comunicação que afeta os centros de controle de tráfego aéreo.

A imprensa americana afirmou que não há indícios de ataque cibernético. A TV Globo apurou com uma fonte que trabalha em uma torre de controle de um aeroporto de Nova York que o problema está relacionado a um cruzamento de frequências de rádio.

O secretário de Segurança Interna dos EUA, Markwayne Mullin, disse que a suspensão se deu por um "problema de telecomunicação" e descartou um possível ataque.

"Até agora, não há sinal de que se trate de um ataque contra nós. Trata-se, por ora, apenas de uma falha nas telecomunicações. Isso levará algum tempo para ser resolvido", disse.

A FAA disse que suspensão foi determinada por circunstâncias extraordinárias e motivos de segurança. Com a medida, aeronaves que estão em solo não podem decolar. Voos internacionais estão sendo analisados caso a caso.

Segundo dados do site de monitoramento FlightAware, quase 7 mil voos nos EUA foram atrasados ou cancelados.

O secretário de Transportes dos Estados Unidos, Sean Duffy, afirmou que a falha atinge todos os centros de controle responsáveis pelo tráfego nas rotas aéreas do país. Técnicos da FAA investigam o problema, segundo ele.

Esta é a segunda vez que a FAA determina a suspensão nacional de todas as decolagens desde os ataques terroristas de 11 de setembro de 2001.

A outra ocorreu em 11 de janeiro de 2023, quando uma falha no sistema de informações aeronáuticas da agência provocou uma paralisação de menos de duas horas. Na ocasião, mais de 1.300 voos foram cancelados e quase 10 mil sofreram atrasos ao longo do dia.

Aviões estão estacionados na pista após a Administração Federal de Aviação dos EUA (FAA) emitir uma ordem nacional de suspensão de voos em solo "devido a circunstâncias extraordinárias e razões de segurança" — Foto: REUTERS/David Ryder TPX IMAGES OF THE DAY

articles.title: SIM-Mulher: Alego aprova sistema de proteção a mulheres em Goiás | G1
articles.standfirst: Proposta do Governo de Goiás prevê integração de dados e serviços de atendimento às vítimas, com informações compartilhadas entre diferentes órgãos. Texto ainda precisa ser votado no plenário da Assembleia Legislativa.
articles.summary: O projeto SIM-Mulher em Goiás integra dados de segurança e saúde para agilizar o atendimento e a proteção de mulheres vítimas de violência doméstica.
articles.body:
Um projeto de lei que pretende integrar os serviços de atendimento a mulheres vítimas de violência doméstica e familiar em Goiás foi aprovado pela Comissão Mista da Assembleia Legislativa de Goiás (Alego), na quarta-feira (11). A proposta prevê a criação do Sistema Integrado de Monitoramento de Dados das Mulheres Goianas (SIM-Mulher), que deve reunir informações sobre os atendimentos prestados às vítimas e facilitar a atuação conjunta dos órgãos responsáveis pela proteção.

De autoria do Governo de Goiás, o projeto foi elaborado pelas secretarias estaduais de Desenvolvimento Social (Seds) e de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (Secti). O texto foi encaminhado à Alego em 5 de novembro, durante o período em que o desembargador Leandro Crispim exercia temporariamente o cargo de governador. A proposta recebeu parecer favorável da deputada Dra. Zeli (PSD), aprovado pela Comissão Mista, mas ainda precisa passar por outras etapas antes de se tornar lei.

Na justificativa enviada aos deputados, o Executivo destacou a dificuldade de comunicação entre os serviços públicos que atendem mulheres em situação de violência. Segundo o governo, a falta de integração pode prejudicar o acompanhamento das vítimas e dificultar o acesso aos serviços de proteção. O documento também aponta que, em 2024, uma média de 56 mulheres solicitaram medidas protetivas por dia em Goiás .

Comissão Mista da Alego aprova projeto que prevê a criação do SIM-Mulher, sistema para integrar o atendimento a mulheres vítimas de violência em Goiás — Foto: Bruna Bonfim/g1

O SIM-Mulher é um sistema previsto para reunir e organizar informações sobre os atendimentos prestados às mulheres em situação de violência doméstica e familiar. A proposta é permitir que diferentes órgãos públicos compartilhem dados de forma segura e acompanhem os encaminhamentos realizados, evitando falhas de comunicação e a repetição desnecessária de procedimentos.

Apesar do nome, o projeto não prevê o monitoramento da localização ou da rotina das vítimas. O artigo 4º estabelece que o acompanhamento será direcionado prioritariamente aos serviços e atendimentos prestados às mulheres. O texto também proíbe a utilização de dados pessoais de maneira que possa expor as usuárias a riscos indevidos.

Segundo o projeto, o SIM-Mulher poderá funcionar em ambiente informatizado, com uma base de dados compartilhada entre os órgãos integrantes da rede de proteção. Os atendimentos deverão ser registrados em um prontuário padronizado, permitindo que os serviços participantes acompanhem os encaminhamentos realizados e organizem a assistência prestada às vítimas.

A proposta abrange sete áreas: assistência social, saúde, segurança pública, Justiça, educação, emprego e renda e habitação. A intenção é que os órgãos atuem de forma articulada para oferecer respostas mais rápidas às mulheres em situação de violência.

O texto também prevê capacitação obrigatória dos profissionais envolvidos, com orientações sobre atendimento humanizado, direitos humanos, legislação de proteção às mulheres e prevenção da revitimização , situação em que a vítima é submetida a novos constrangimentos durante o atendimento institucional.

Os detalhes técnicos sobre a comunicação entre os sistemas ainda deverão ser definidos em regulamentação específica, elaborada por um grupo de trabalho interinstitucional coordenado pela Seds.

Quem terá acesso às informações das vítimas?

O projeto estabelece que o acesso às informações será restrito a servidores públicos previamente credenciados, com autenticação individual e possibilidade de rastreamento e auditoria dos acessos. O compartilhamento deverá respeitar a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD) , com medidas para preservar a intimidade e a segurança das mulheres atendidas.

Dados considerados sensíveis deverão ser anonimizados quando utilizados em levantamentos estatísticos, estudos ou relatórios públicos. O texto também prevê punições administrativas, civis e penais para responsáveis por vazamentos , violações de sigilo ou uso indevido das informações.

Todos os municípios serão obrigados a participar?

Não. A participação dos municípios será facultativa. Para aderir ao SIM-Mulher, cada prefeitura deverá encaminhar uma solicitação ao Governo de Goiás e formalizar um convênio ou instrumento semelhante.

A gestão estadual ficará sob responsabilidade da Seds, enquanto o Comitê Gestor da Rede Estadual pelo Fim da Violência Contra a Mulher deverá acompanhar e fiscalizar a execução do sistema. O governo também poderá criar incentivos, como certificações e selos de reconhecimento, para os municípios participantes que apresentarem melhorias nos indicadores de enfrentamento à violência.

Imagem ilustrativa de violência contra a mulher — Foto: Jainni Victória/Arquivo g1

Segundo a justificativa encaminhada à Alego, a proposta não deverá gerar novas despesas obrigatórias. O governo informou que a implantação será realizada com serviços e recursos orçamentários já previstos, que poderão ser suplementados conforme a disponibilidade financeira.

O projeto também estabelece a publicação anual de um relatório com dados consolidados do SIM-Mulher. O sistema deverá atuar de maneira complementar ao Observatório Estadual da Violência Contra a Mulher, responsável pela coleta e análise de estatísticas sobre a violência de gênero.

Ainda não há uma data definida para a implantação . O projeto foi aprovado pela Comissão Mista da Alego, mas precisa avançar na tramitação legislativa, incluindo a votação em plenário. Se aprovado pelos deputados, seguirá para sanção ou veto do governador.

Mesmo que seja sancionada, a lei dependerá de regulamentações para definir aspectos operacionais, como a integração entre os sistemas, os níveis de acesso às informações e os procedimentos de adesão dos municípios.

Sede da Assembleia Legislativa de Goiás — Foto: Maykon Cardoso/Alego

articles.title: How will the US deal with Nvidia scandal?
articles.summary: Tech giant CEO resigned and will testify before Congress.
articles.body:
Jensen Huang, tech superstar, and now former chief executive of Nvidia, is due to appear before the United States Congress.

He has admitted to having an affair with a woman accused of having links to Chinese intelligence.

Nvidia says no company data has been compromised and there were no breaches of national security. But the FBI and the Department of Justice have launched investigations.

Could this damage the US chip-manufacturing industry?

And how will the US deal with potential spying at the highest levels of one of the world’s most valuable companies?

articles.title: Livros didáticos encalhados na Seduc AM: prejuízo de R$ 500 milhões | G1
articles.standfirst: Livros deveriam ter sido entregues para os estudantes da rede estadual de ensino desde 2021, mas nunca chegaram aos alunos. Prejuízos aos cofres públicos somam mais de R$ 500 milhões.
articles.summary: Fiscalização encontra 16 milhões de livros didáticos encalhados na Seduc AM e materiais escolares abandonados que somam prejuízo de R$ 500 milhões ao estado.
articles.body:
Uma fiscalização da equipe de transição do governador eleito Omar Aziz encontrou 16 milhões de livros encalhados , desde 2021, que deveriam ter sido entregues para os estudantes da rede estadual de ensino no depósito da Secretaria de Estado de Educação (Seduc), na Torquato Tapajós, Zona Norte de Manaus . Os prejuízos aos cofres públicos somam mais de R$ 500 milhões .

Os vídeos gravados na terça-feira (10), e obtidos pela Rede Amazônica , mostram centenas de livros que deveriam ser destinados à preparação para o Exame Nacional do Ensino Médio (Enem) de 2024. Naquele ano, o Amazonas registrou média de 505,3 pontos no Enem .

No Ranking de Competitividade dos Estados, elaborado pelo Centro de Liderança Pública (CLP), o estado teve o pior desempenho no exame .

Neste ano, também ficou entre os quatro piores colocados no indicador geral de educação, com base em dados do Índice de Desenvolvimento da Educação Básica (Ideb), à frente apenas de Pará, Acre e Amapá.

Equipe de transição encontra mais de 16 milhões de livros didáticos encalhados em galpão da Seduc. — Foto: Reprodução

Além dos livros, os registros mostram estoques de uniformes escolares, impressoras, computadores, monitores, aparelhos de ar-condicionado, televisores, móveis, materiais de cozinha e equipamentos de informática. Parte dos itens tem identificação de fabricação ou aquisição entre 2021 e 2026.

Em uma das gravações, a vice-governadora eleita do Amazonas, Alessandra Campelo (PSD) questiona a compra de novos equipamentos sem a utilização dos anteriores. Ao observar itens identificados como de 2026, ela comenta que havia equipamentos de anos anteriores ainda armazenados.

“Eles compram de 2026 sem ter usado nem o de 2024, né. Essas aqui... são de quando? Não consigo ver a data. Mas são vários. Estão aqui há um ano, dois anos, três anos, a gente tá em último lugar [Enem]”, disse.

Segundo a procuradora-geral de Justiça do Amazonas, Leda Mara, o Ministério Público irá investigar o suposto abandono desses materiais didáticos que se encontram armazenados na Secretaria Estadual de Educação.

“A não chegada desse material aos seus destinatários é algo que causa preocupação e que vai merecer do Ministério Público a investigação necessária para apurar as razões desse material não ter chegado até os estudantes. A não chegada desse material aos estudantes pode ter sim causado um prejuízo muito grande para os nossos alunos que precisam desse material didático para eh, a ampliação do conhecimento” , comentou Leda Mara.

A procuradora explicou que a investigação deverá avaliar se houve prejuízo aos cofres públicos e comprometimento da prestação do serviço educacional. Neste primeiro momento, o caso será analisado pelas promotorias de patrimônio público e educação, sem encaminhamento à esfera criminal.

Em nota, a equipe de transição informou que está na fase inicial de coleta, organização e análise de dados dos órgãos e secretarias do Governo do Amazonas.

O grupo afirmou que não emitirá conclusões sobre situações específicas neste momento. Segundo a nota, todas as informações recebidas, incluindo denúncias e possíveis indícios de irregularidades, passarão por análise, cruzamento de dados e validação técnica.

A Rede Amazônica questionou o governo do Estado, mas até a publicação desta reportagem não obteve resposta.

articles.standfirst: Ao menos 129 pessoas estavam a bordo de embarcação turística, segundo porto de New Orleans.
articles.summary: Ao menos 129 pessoas estavam a bordo de embarcação turística, segundo porto de New Orleans.
articles.body:
Equipes de emergência atuam em New Orleans após petroleiro bater em barco de cruzeiro — Foto: Enan Chediak / Enan Chediak/The Advocate via AP

Um navio petroleiro se chocou com um barco de cruzeiro no rio Mississippi, em New Orleans, nos Estados Unidos . Imagens mostram as cenas logo após a colisão e o cruzeiro afundando.

Navio cruzeiro é visto parcialmente afundado após ser atingido por petroleiro em New Orleans. — Foto: Enan Chediak / Enan Chediak/The Advocate via AP

Petroleiro bate em navio de cruzeiro no rio Mississippi, nos EUA — Foto: Reprodução: Redes Sociais

O barco de turismo estava atracado, fazendo o desembarque de seus cerca de 129 passageiros a bordo, além dos tripulantes, segundo a rede de televisão Fox News.

O petroleiro pertence à empresa Atlantic Asphalt, enquanto o barco turístico é da American Cruise Lines. A colisão aconteceu por volta das 12h30 no horário local (15h30 na hora de Brasília), nas proximidades da ponte Crescent City Connection, na região de Jefferson Parish, segundo a emissora de TV local WDSU.

Equipes da polícia portuária, dos departamentos de polícia e de bombeiros de Nova Orleans, da Guarda Costeira dos Estados Unidos e profissionais de emergência médica foram enviados ao local.

Em comunicado, o porto da cidade afirmou que a prioridade é garantir a segurança dos passageiros, tripulantes e profissionais envolvidos no resgate.

O órgão informou que a ocorrência ainda está em andamento. Até a última atualização desta reportagem, o número de feridos e a causa da colisão não haviam sido confirmados.

O governador da Louisiana, Jeff Landry, afirmou estar ciente do acidente e que seguia para Nova Orleans por volta das 14h (17h no horário de Brasília), segundo a Fox News.

articles.title: Women at the controls, solar power on the rooftops: What makes Pune Metro's Pink Line special
articles.summary: On November 3, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for Pune Metro projects worth around Rs 21,800 crore.
articles.body: On November 3, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for Pune Metro projects worth around Rs 21,800 crore.The project he inaugurated was Line 3 of Pune Metro, popularly known as the Pink Line. Built at a cost of approximately Rs 8,300 crore, the 23.2-km corridor connects Maan, on Pune's northwestern outskirts, with the District Court Metro station in Shivajinagar, central Pune. Also known as Civil Court station, it serves as an interchange with Line 1 (Purple Line) and Line 2 (Aqua Line), connecting passengers to other parts of the Metro network.PM Modi described the Pink Line as "so special". Beyond the connectivity it offers, the corridor stands out for its distinctive approach to operations, infrastructure development and sustainability.Why Pune needed the MetroOver the years, Pune's population has grown significantly, with people from other parts of Maharashtra as well as outside the state migrating to the city. Pune was home to over 12 lakh people in 1981, according to that year's national census. The figure rose to more than 31 lakh in 2011, the latest national census, meaning the city added around 19 lakh people in 30 years – an increase of nearly 160%.(function(){function e(){window.addEventListener(`message`,function(e){if(e.data[`datawrapper-height`]!==void 0){var t=document.querySelectorAll(`iframe`);for(var n in e.data[`datawrapper-height`])for(var r=0,i;i=t[r];r++)if(i.contentWindow===e.source){var a=e.data[`datawrapper-height`][n]+`px`;i.style.height=a}}})}e()})();Migration to Pune and the subsequent population expansion have largely been driven by the growth of its IT, manufacturing and educational sectors. Pune is counted among India's leading IT hubs, alongside Bengaluru and Hyderabad. Several prominent colleges and universities are also located in the city, further contributing to its growing population and demand for public transport.Against this backdrop, the foundation stone for the first phase of Pune Metro, comprising the Purple and Aqua lines, was laid in December 2016. The network's commercial operations commenced in March 2022.Although the launch of Pune Metro improved connectivity, several important areas remained outside its network, limiting its reach. The Pink Line addresses part of this gap by connecting Hinjawadi to the existing Metro network.Why the Pink Line mattersThe significance of the Pink Line extends beyond it being just another corridor of the Pune Metro network. Before the route opened to the public on November 4, a day after its inauguration, the network had no connectivity to Hinjawadi, one of Pune's largest employment centres and a major IT hub. The area houses offices of major technology companies such as Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro and Cognizant.The Purple Line, which runs between Pimpri-Chinchwad and Swargate, and the Aqua Line, connecting Vanaz and Ramwadi, were the only two operational corridors at the time. As a result, software professionals living in other parts of Pune had to rely on road transport to commute to Hinjawadi or relocate closer to their workplaces.With 17 of the corridor's stations now operational and the remaining six scheduled to open in March 2027, commuters can interchange at District Court station in Shivajinagar and travel directly to Hinjawadi, making daily commutes more seamless.Commuters have also expressed hope that the Pink Line will ease congestion on roads leading to Hinjawadi.“The entire stretch from Wakad to Hinjawadi Phase-II remains busy and chaotic during rush hours. We expect relief from these snarls,” a commuter told The Times of India in an earlier report.Another commuter, who travels by bike to his workplace at Balewadi near Hinjawadi, noted that the Metro journey took nearly as much time as his two-wheeler commute but offered greater comfort.“My travel time by bike would be around 30-45 minutes, depending on the traffic. It took about 30 minutes to reach Balewadi by Metro. There was no huge drop in the travel time, but the overall comfort in Metro was much more,” he added.Another important feature of the Pink Line, officials say, is its provision for last-mile connectivity through bus services, dedicated pickup zones for taxis and auto-rickshaws, and cycle parking at stations.With the Pink Line now open, the Aqua and Purple lines being expanded, and a fourth corridor taking shape, the focus will increasingly be on integrating the expanding Metro network with other transport modes to improve connectivity across Pune.Women at the controlsIn October 2011, a woman loco pilot, Priyanka N, drove the inaugural train of Namma Metro in Bengaluru. Since then, several Metro networks across the country have employed women as train operators.However, Pune has taken this a step further by introducing an entire Metro corridor where all train drivers are women.While other Metro networks in India, including Delhi and Bengaluru, also have corridors designated as the Pink Line, Pune's newest Metro corridor has a special significance attached to the name. Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said the corridor would be called the Pink Line because its trains would be operated exclusively by women.Nearly 15 years after Priyanka N drove the first Namma Metro train, Pune Metro's Pink Line has become India's first Metro corridor to have an all-women team of train drivers.As many as 90 women have completed training and obtained competency certificates to operate trains on the Hinjawadi–Shivajinagar route. Recruited through campus drives, they underwent classroom instruction, practical sessions and extensive on-track training before being cleared to operate passenger services. The women have since taken charge of regular train operations on the corridor.Overall, the plan is to have 100 women operators on the line, including the 90 already operating trains on it.Having an entire Metro corridor with women at the controls also marks a significant step towards greater representation of women in operational roles in urban rail transport.A Metro corridor powered partly by solar energyAnother important feature of Pune Metro's Pink Line is that 30% of its energy requirements are expected to be met through solar power. The project also uses a 750V DC third-rail electrification system, which eliminates the need for overhead wires.Tata Power Renewables has received a contract from Pune IT City Metro Rail Ltd, which operates Pune Metro Line 3, to install a 7.67 MWp rooftop solar project. The installation will cover all 23 stations and the Metro depot. The electricity generated will be used for captive consumption. The project is expected to help reduce the corridor's operating costs and dependence on conventional sources of electricity.With this, Pune Metro joins several transport projects in India, including other Metro systems, that use solar power. For instance, as of 2023, 35% of Delhi Metro's total energy consumption came from renewable sources. This included 30% from its off-site solar power plant in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh, 4% from rooftop solar panels and 1% from the waste-to-energy plant in Ghazipur, Delhi.Outside the Metro network, Cochin International Airport in Kerala became the world's first airport to run entirely on solar power with the commissioning of a 12 MWp solar PV power plant in 2015.The solar power component, therefore, adds another dimension to the Pink Line's approach to energy use and operational efficiency.India's first Metro project under the 2017 Metro policy's PPP frameworkThe Pink Line is also significant for the model through which it has been developed. It is India's first Metro rail project to be implemented under the public-private partnership (PPP) framework of the Centre's New Metro Rail Policy, 2017, which aims to encourage private investment in transport infrastructure.While cities such as Mumbai and Hyderabad have previously developed Metro projects under PPP models, Pune's Pink Line is the first to be implemented under the framework of the 2017 policy.The project was developed by Pune IT City Metro Rail Limited, a special-purpose company established as a joint venture between TRIL Urban Transport Private Limited, part of the Tata Group, and Germany's Siemens, in collaboration with the Pune Metropolitan Region Development Authority.Another technological feature of the Pink Line is its Siemens-supplied Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC) signalling system. While the existing Purple and Aqua lines also use CBTC systems, these are supplied by France's Alstom.According to Siemens, its CBTC system allows trains to communicate continuously with trackside equipment, enabling high-frequency services while maintaining safe distances between trains. It is designed for semi-automated operations, with provision for a future upgrade to fully automated, driverless operations.The technology adds to the corridor's operational capabilities while leaving scope for greater automation in the future.Beyond Metro connectivityDespite these features and the integration of Hinjawadi into the Metro network, several challenges remain in improving the overall commuting experience in the city, experts say.For instance, despite the Pink Line reportedly recording a ridership of around 50,000 on its very first day, some passengers raised concerns about gaps in first- and last-mile connectivity.According to Tanzeel Allapur, programme associate at Parisar, a Pune-based NGO working on sustainable urban transport since 1995, the administration cannot limit its idea of a good commuting experience to building new Metro lines alone and must focus on improving connectivity to and from Metro stations.“Finding a connecting bus or shared auto, figuring out where to board, and navigating the surroundings of a Metro station all add to the mental effort involved in making that journey. The administration needs to focus on reducing both the physical friction and the cognitive load involved in these transfers,” she told The Times of India.Echoing this view, Jagannarayan Padmanabhan, senior director at Crisil Intelligence, stressed the importance of seamless connectivity rather than simply adding more routes.“Seamless connectivity with PMPML buses, feeder services, autos and shared mobility, supported by integrated ticketing and pedestrian infrastructure, is essential,” he added.Although it is still early days for the Pink Line, improved connectivity and integration with other modes of transport could further build on the benefits it brings to Pune's public transport network.The way forward for Pune Metro's Pink LineLooking ahead, transport activist Ranjit Gadgil, who heads Parisar, said that with the Pink Line now operational alongside the two existing corridors, authorities must introduce measures to curb private vehicle use to reduce congestion, pollution and road accidents.“With the addition of the Pink Line to the existing two corridors, it is high time the city started implementing measures to curb vehicle use. These could include on-street parking charges, low-emission zones and street designs that prioritise the safety and movement of pedestrians, cyclists and buses rather than allocating more space to motor vehicles,” he added.Ultimately, the Pink Line offers Pune an opportunity to make public transport a more convenient choice for commuters. Its connectivity to Hinjawadi, in particular, could encourage more people working in the IT hub to consider the Metro for their daily journeys.But the real measure of the Pink Line's success will be whether it can persuade more people to leave their cars and two-wheelers behind and make public transport their preferred choice.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: 'I'm not gonna be cowered': US Treasury chief on moving to military base over Iran threats
articles.summary: Washington's economic war on Iran may be beginning to bite Tehran, but the man spearheading the campaign is now facing a backlash of his own.
articles.body: Washington's economic war on Iran may be beginning to bite Tehran, but the man spearheading the campaign is now facing a backlash of his own.US treasury secretary Scott Bessent has revealed that he was forced to move from his Washington residence to a military base following death threats linked to Iran.But Bessent is refusing to be intimidated, arguing that the threats against him and other senior US officials show that President Donald Trump's financial squeeze on Tehran is working.His message to Iran's leadership was blunt: "F the Iranian leadership. I'm not gonna be cowered."Speaking during an interview with CNBC, Bessent said the threats were directed not only at him but also at other members of Trump's cabinet. He linked the threats to Washington's economic offensive against Tehran, dubbed "Operation Economic Outcast", arguing that the campaign was beginning to hurt Iran.Describing the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) as increasingly desperate under mounting economic pressure, Bessent compared its actions to those of a "dangerous cornered animal".He also said he saw no reason to be intimidated when American military personnel stationed in the Gulf and President Donald Trump himself continued to face death threats."And, you know, why am I gonna be afraid when our brave military personnel in the Gulf, President Trump constantly receives death threats? And, you know, what we are doing is working, and the IRGC, they're like a dangerous cornered animal," he said.Bessent has led the Trump administration's economic pressure campaign against Iran since August. According to Reuters, Operation Economic Outcast involves sanctions targeting financial institutions and services in the Middle East that facilitate transactions with Tehran. The campaign, combined with a US naval blockade of Iranian ports, is aimed at pressuring Iran to end attacks on shipping and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.The security concerns come amid broader US intelligence warnings about Iranian targeting efforts. A senior intelligence official in the Trump administration warned in a memo seen by Reuters last month that Iranian plots against US personnel and American citizens had reached an "advanced stage".Bessent also accused The Wall Street Journal of compromising his security by publishing an aerial photograph of his Georgetown residence in January 2025, which he said contained information that made the property geolocatable. He claimed his team had appealed to the newspaper's editor not to disclose the location."So, I follow the Secret Service instructions and have moved from my home to a military base," Bessent told CNBC, before describing the newspaper's decision as "highly irresponsible and dangerous".Trump, meanwhile, issued a fresh warning to Tehran, saying those responsible for killing a US official "will not exist any longer". articles.title: In 2016, Boston construction crews uncovered a burned 19th-century ship beneath the Seaport; its abandoned lime cargo linked the wreck to the city’s building boom
articles.summary: In 2016, construction crews uncovered a burned 19th-century ship beneath Boston's Seaport District, revealing its lime cargo that links to the city's historic building boom in the 19th century.
articles.body: Boston Seaport District was once part of a busy harbour, where ships transported materials that supported the growth. Much of that maritime history now lies beneath modern buildings. According to Content Boston, in May 2016, construction workers uncovered a burnt wooden vessel while preparing the foundation for a new office building. The ship still contained partially burnt barrels of lime, offering clues about the trade that supplied Boston's expanding construction industry during the 19th century.Construction work exposed the buried schooner The site of the find was located at 121 Seaport Boulevard during the process of excavating the building's foundation. The spot used to be part of South Boston Flats, a mud flat covered with water that was gradually turned into land. According to the City of Boston Archaeology Program, the wooden hull lay under 20 feet of fill when two H-piles driven in during construction struck the wreck. Skanska halted construction work at the site and hired the Public Archaeology Laboratory (PAL) to investigate the discovery. Assistance in the research was provided by archaeologists from the city of Boston, the Massachusetts Historical Commission, the Board of Underwater Archaeological Resources and David S. Robinson and Associates.According to the City of Boston Archaeology Program, the surviving hull measured 47 feet long and 15 feet wide. Its stem was missing, but archaeologists estimated that the original vessel was between 60 and 80 feet long. Two mast steps indicated that it was a two-masted schooner, likely a type known as a pinky. The City of Boston archaeological report documents these findings.Lime barrel pointed to a possible Rockland connectionArchaeologists discovered dozens of partially burned wooden barrels filled with lime. They were roughly 1.5 to 2.5 feet in size and bound together with natural birch hoops. The partially visible stencil “ROCKLA” on the barrel lead indicated that the lime shipment came from Rockland, Maine, one of the principal centres of lime production in the mid to late 19th century.Lime was an essential component of the mortar required in the masonry construction process. Boston required a lot of time in the development of its Financial District, Back Bay, Beacon Hill and South End Neighbourhoods. This cargo may indicate a link between the schooner and the city's construction activities. According to the City of Boston, historical records of a similar-sized lime schooner documented a cargo of more than 1,200 barrels of lime. Archaeologists believe the Seaport Shipwreck may have carried a similar load.West lime may have contributed to the ship's destructionFire seems to have been a major factor in the sinking of the ship because of all the blackened areas on its hull and cargo. This is based on the fact that lime reacts exothermically when in contact with water, releasing heat in the process. As for the exact cause of the fire, it still remains unknown. One piece of evidence that can help explain this mystery is the orientation of the ship. This is because the bow of the ship faces northeast and seems to indicate that it had been out to the South Boston Flats and left there intentionally. The Massachusetts Board of Underwater Archaeological Resources’ minutes from its May 26, 2016 meeting also recorded the discovery and described the vessel as a likely lime schooner that burned and was abandoned at the site.Artifacts helped narrow down the sinking periodHousehold items that were found included ironstone dishes, a knife, a tobacco pipe made from clay and two three-tinned forks. The three-tinned forks proved to be especially helpful since the design was invented in 1869. The City of Boston notes that the site began to be filled in 1885, which places the sinking somewhere between 1869 and 1885. When considered alongside evidence dating the wreck to no earlier than 1869, this places its sinking between 1869 and 1885. The name of the ship is unknown and it seems that it was built at the beginning of the 19th century, judging by the compass timbers on board.Archaeologists documented the risk before its removalThe removal of the ship took place after it was documented and divided into several large pieces to allow work to proceed on site. Flatbed trucks were used to transport the remains to be studied later. There were 13 archival pieces, which included parts of the ship's keel, hull planking and barrels. The Massachusetts Board's archaeological records provide further context about the state’s work to document and protect maritime heritage. The Boston discovery preserved a record of the trade that supported the city‘s growth, even though the schooner's identity and exact fate remain unresolved.You use AI every day. articles.title: A $25,000 grant from Microsoft cofounder Paul Allen's family foundation helped keep a historic Washington art gallery open in 2025; it has now received a third grant as 745 arts groups share $10 million
articles.summary: A $25,000 grant from the family foundation of Microsoft cofounder Paul Allen helped keep the Old Hotel Art Gallery in Othello, Washington, open during a
articles.body: A $25,000 grant from the family foundation of Microsoft cofounder Paul Allen helped keep the Old Hotel Art Gallery in Othello, Washington, open during a difficult stretch in 2025, according to ArtsFund’s 2026 Community Accelerator Grantee announcement. The gallery has now received a third $25,000 grant, part of a broader $10 million distribution to 745 arts and culture organisations across Washington state, as reported by GeekWire and ArtsFund.The funding is not tied to a specific project, which gives smaller organisations the flexibility to pay staff, cover rent, improve buildings, or sustain programming. For the Old Hotel Art Gallery, that flexibility proved decisive, allowing it to bridge a financial gap and continue serving its community. Read more about it here, as per the reports:A gallery with a historyThe Old Hotel Art Gallery is located in Othello, a city in Adams County in central Washington. It operates from a historic building that has become an important cultural space for the surrounding community, offering exhibitions and arts programming in an area that can be easily overlooked by larger arts funders.The gallery received $25,000 grants in each of 2024, 2025, and 2026 through the Community Accelerator Grant program. That consistency has allowed the organisation to plan beyond a single year rather than constantly scrambling to cover basic operating costs.Gallery director Samantha Copas said, as per ArtsFund, that the 2025 award “truly kept our doors open.” The funding helped the gallery support a living wage for staff, bridge a gap until its annual fundraiser, and make improvements and renovations to the historic building.What the money made possibleThe grant did more than prevent a closure. It enabled the Old Hotel Art Gallery to invest in its building, which opened the door to a new revenue stream through rental income. That kind of practical investment can change an organisation’s financial outlook over time.For many small arts groups, the difference between surviving and closing often comes down to a few months of cash flow. A grant that covers payroll, rent, or facility repairs can buy time for an organisation to stabilise and continue its work.The Old Hotel Art Gallery’s experience shows how unrestricted funding can have a multiplier effect. Money used to improve a building can create rental income, which can then support staff, programming, and future operations.A statewide funding effortThe 2026 Community Accelerator Grant awarded $10 million to 745 arts and culture organisations across Washington. Grants ranged from $2,500 to $25,000, reaching organisations in 37 of the state’s 39 counties, as per the reports.The program is administered by ArtsFund and funded by Allen Family Philanthropies, formerly known as the Paul G. Allen Family Foundation. It was created to provide flexible, unrestricted funding to cultural nonprofits whose primary mission is to produce or support arts and cultural activities. The 2026 round focused on organisations with annual budgets under $1 million. That change narrowed the applicant pool but increased the average award size by about 25 percent, from $10,753 in 2025 to $13,423 in 2026.Why small organisations matterThe decision to focus on smaller organisations reflects a broader concern about the health of Washington’s creative sector. According to ArtsFund, organisations with annual budgets under $1 million lost an average of one staff position between 2023 and 2024, while larger organisations added an average of five.That imbalance matters because small groups often serve communities that larger institutions cannot reach as easily. They may be the only arts organisation in a rural county, the only venue for local artists, or the only place where residents can access cultural programming close to home.More than 22 percent of the 2026 grantees are located in rural counties, and the program includes 12 of Washington’s 29 federally recognised tribes. The reach of the funding is therefore not just about dollars, it is about making sure cultural life is supported across the entire state.How the money is usedAlthough the grants are unrestricted, applicants are asked to prioritise how they will use the funds. In 2026, the leading uses cited by grantees were programming, salaries and labour, and rent, mortgage, and facility upgrades.That order makes sense for organisations trying to stay afloat. Programming keeps audiences engaged, salaries keep staff in place, and facility costs determine whether an organisation can physically operate at all.The program also keeps reporting requirements low, with no formal reporting required from grantees. That approach reduces administrative burden and allows organisations to spend more time on their work rather than on paperwork.A commitment to continueArtsFund and Allen Family Philanthropies have also announced a renewal of the Community Accelerator Grant for 2027, unlocking another $10 million for Washington’s arts and culture sector. That brings the program’s total funding to $50 million over five years.The renewal follows a report analysing data from the first three years of the program. It found that 84 percent of organisations that received funding across all three years increased investment in staff, expanded programming, and diversified revenue.Those findings suggest that the grants are doing more than providing short-term relief. They are helping organisations build capacity and resilience, which is especially important in a sector where funding can be unpredictable.What it means for communitiesFor places like Othello, the value of a grant like this goes beyond the gallery itself. It supports jobs, brings people together, gives local artists a platform, and helps preserve a historic building that might otherwise deteriorate.The Old Hotel Art Gallery’s story is a reminder that cultural institutions do not need to be large to be essential. Sometimes, a $25,000 grant is enough to keep the lights on, pay staff, repair a roof, and make sure a community continues to have a place where art and creativity can thrive.As the program enters its fifth year, the challenge will be sustaining that support over time. But the commitment to another $10 million in 2027 suggests that both ArtsFund and Allen Family Philanthropies see the value in continuing to invest in the organisations that keep Washington’s cultural life alive.You use AI every day. articles.summary: A home surveillance camera has captured the terrifying moment a three-storey apartment building in Brooklyn, New York, collapsed, killing eight people and
articles.body: A home surveillance camera has captured the terrifying moment a three-storey apartment building in Brooklyn, New York, collapsed, killing eight people and injuring 18 others.The six-second video shows a family inside their third-floor apartment just moments before the walls give way and debris engulfs the room.The footage, obtained by Gothamist and CBS News, was recorded inside the apartment of resident Anderson Velez at 1321 Flatbush Avenue.Velez lived there with his wife and two young sons. The building collapsed next to an active construction site, prompting authorities to investigate whether work at the site may have contributed to the disaster.At the beginning of the video, Velez's nine-year-old son can be seen taking a gallon of milk from the refrigerator while his two-year-old brother plays on the floor.Their mother then opens the door to the living room and screams. The older boy runs towards her, moving away from the wall just before it collapses. The toddler was swept into the rubble but survived with scrapes to his forehead and legs.Recalling his condition after he was rescued, Velez told Gothamist in Spanish, according to the New York Post: "His ears were full of dirt, his nose, his little mouth, his back, his entire body was covered in dirt."Velez was in the Bronx for work when the building collapsed. He said his wife called him in panic as she pleaded with rescue workers to pull their children from the debris.His wife suffered serious injuries to her ribs, spine and collarbone, while their nine-year-old son remains in intensive care after undergoing surgery.Velez said the family had moved into the apartment earlier this month after living in a homeless shelter. They are now staying at a Brooklyn hotel arranged by the city for people displaced by the collapse.The collapse claimed eight lives, including those of two children aged nine and 10. Two of the deceased were construction workers, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said.Six people died at the scene, while two others succumbed to their injuries at nearby hospitals. The 18 injured included 14 civilians and four firefighters."As of now, we have confirmed that two of those who died were construction workers," Mamdani said while briefing reporters on Thursday. "The vast majority of those still being treated in hospitals are in stable condition. One person is in critical condition," he added.The New York City Fire Department (FDNY) said it had completed search and recovery operations at the site and found no further victims. The site was subsequently handed over to the city's Department of Buildings and Police Department for further investigation.The collapse has raised questions about the building's condition before the accident.You use AI every day. articles.title: State govt forms panel to probe Karnatak University land encroachments
articles.summary: State govt forms panel to verify Karnatak University’s 888-acre land records, trace missing documents and probe alleged encroachment of up to 200 acres.
articles.body: Dharwad: State govt has constituted a committee to verify Karnatak University’s land records and identify alleged encroachments on its property following complaints of large-scale occupation.The committee, headed by the deputy commissioner, will meet on Nov 16 or 17 and submit its report within a month. It includes KU vice-chancellor Prof AM Khan, the tahsildar, commissioners of Hubballi-Dharwad Urban Development Authority and Hubballi-Dharwad Municipal Corporation, and the assistant director of land records.Govt acted after Khan wrote to chief minister’s office seeking intervention to verify the university’s records and reclaim encroached land.Khan said KU, Karnataka’s second-oldest university, owns about 888 acres. Records for nearly 700 acres are available, while documents concerning the remaining 188 acres have yet to be traced and verified.The exercise will examine survey numbers, mutation registers and land records to establish ownership and determine the extent of encroachment. University authorities suspect nearly 200 acres may have been encroached upon over the years, with layouts and permanent structures built on some portions. Preliminary observations have also indicated encroachments along parts of the campus boundary.Accessing and interpreting old records remains a major challenge. Several documents are in Modi script and some in Marathi, requiring translation into Kannada and scrutiny to establish ownership.The exercise is expected to demarcate the university’s boundaries and facilitate measures to recover encroached property.Stay updated with the latest Hubballi news. articles.title: Engineer loses ₹1.3 lakh in credit card KYC scam
articles.summary: Mangaluru cyber fraud cases: engineer, truck driver and retired banker lose ₹1.3 lakh, ₹4.2 lakh and ₹2 lakh in APK, KYC and eChallan scams.
articles.body: Mangaluru: A 47-year-old ship engineer lost Rs 1.3 lakh after cyber fraudsters, posing as bank representatives, allegedly tricked him into sharing his credit card details and downloading APK file under the pretext of updating his KYC details. According to the complaint filed with the CEN police, he received a call on his mobile phone from an unknown number around 3pm on Wednesday. He then shared his credit card details with the caller who claimed to be a bank employee. The caller then told him that a video call was required to update his KYC details and sent him an APK link. When the complainant clicked on the link, a video call was initiated but was disconnected shortly thereafter. Subsequently, a total of Rs 1,36,896 got transferred in multiple transactions from the complainant’s credit card which was now attached to another bank without his knowledge. CEN Crime police registered a case.Truck driver loses ₹4 lakh in fake traffic violation ticketA truck driver, 41, lost Rs 4.2 lakh after cybercriminals allegedly sent him a fake RTO traffic violation message and tricked him into downloading a malicious mobile application. According to the complaint, on Oct 31, around 9.34am, the complainant received a message on his mobile : “Traffic violation CCTV footage pay online”. Along with this, his truck registration number and a link were sent. When he clicked the link, an application named ‘eChallan (mParivahan)’ was allegedly downloaded onto his phone without his knowledge. Subsequently, on Nov 10, he alleged that a total of Rs 4,26,434 was transferred in multiple transactions from his savings bank account to an unknown account without his knowledge. CEN Crime police have registered a case.Pension card scam: Retired bank employee loses ₹2 lakhA 77-year-old retired bank employee lost Rs 2 lakh to a fake Facebook advertisement offering a pension card. According to the complaint, Wednesday, the complainant came across the ad for a ‘retired pension card’. After clicking it, he entered his name, address and PAN card details. At 4.46pm, he received a call from an unidentified person who told him that since he applied online for the pension card, his bank account details were needed to be provided. The complainant shared the information and subsequently, an APK file named ‘Pension card’ was downloaded onto his mobile phone without his knowledge. Later, a total of Rs 2,09,000 was transferred in multiple transactions from his bank account without his knowledge or consent.Stay updated with the latest Mangaluru news. Download the TOI App.

articles.summary: US Senator John Kennedy (R-Louisiana) has mocked former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over his admitted extramarital affair with a Chinese businesswoman
articles.body: US Senator John Kennedy (R-Louisiana) has mocked former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over his admitted extramarital affair with a Chinese businesswoman suspected of spying for Beijing, saying anyone having an affair should at least make sure their partner is not a Chinese spy. During an interview with CNN anchor Kasie Hunt on Thursday, Kennedy delivered his comical jibe at Huang as he said he did not recommend extramarital affairs but one should at least check the LinkedIn profile of the other person. "Kasie, my jaw is still stuck on the floor. I mean, I'm not naive. I'm not Bambi's baby brother. I know people have affairs. I don't recommend it. But if you do, if you do, you ought to make sure it's not with a Chinese spy. I mean, check their LinkedIn page, for God's sakes," Kennedy said."And it's like, allegedly, he's a double agent cheater. Then he cheated on the spy!" Senator Kennedy said, making it look more comical.Huang, who stepped down as Nvidia CEO on Thursday, has acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife as he accepted his relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman and former executive associated with Singapore-based technology company Megaspeed International. More secret affairs came out of the closet, but US intelligence is worried about whether Alice Huang had links to China's Ministry of State Security and used her relationship with the Nvidia chief to obtain information. Beijing has rejected the espionage allegations.More serious question is...Kennedy said the more serious question was whether US government officials had properly scrutinized the sale of advanced American chips to a company linked to the woman. "Apparently, the Department of Commerce greenlit the sale of $4 billion in advanced chips to the spy's company," he said. Kennedy said he wanted to hear from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and, in particular, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick."I mean, why were they selling the chips? Did they follow the trail? How do they know the chips went to the company and not to the Communist Party of China?" he asked."Here's a man, head of one of the most powerful companies in the world. More than anybody else in the private sector, he's been making AI policy for America, and certainly with respect to our relationship with China. And then we learn about this," Kennedy said.Should Howard Lutnick also lose his job?Hunt also asked Kennedy whether Lutnick should lose his job over the controversy. The Louisiana Republican said he had not reached a conclusion but suggested the commerce secretary should publicly address the allegations. "Well, I don't know yet," Kennedy said. "If I were the secretary, I would have called a press conference already." He said Lutnick should tell the American public: "Look, I'll be here as long as you want. I'm prepared to answer all questions."Kennedy added that Lutnick would be called to testify before Congress and stressed that the matter was extremely serious."This is serious as an aneurysm. articles.title: KFC brings fast-food to famed Italian ski slopes as proud locals revolt
articles.summary: Fast-food chain KFC isn't welcome as it prepares to open two restaurants on ski slopes in Cortina d'Ampezzo and Madonna di Campiglio, sparking fierce backlash.
articles.body: Colonel Sanders is getting a frosty reception in the Italian Alps as KFC prepares to open restaurants in two upscale ski towns, sparking backlash from those determined to preserve the mountain villages' character and traditions. The Kentucky-founded fast-food giant is set to reach new heights on Dec. 5, when two restaurants will open on the slopes of Cortina d'Ampezzo, a southern Dolomite resort village, and Madonna di Campiglio, an Alpine town in the Trentino region of northern Italy. The move makes KFC the first fast-food company to operate on Italian ski trails. KFC UNVEILS RADICALLY DIFFERENT RESTAURANT IN MAJOR COMEBACK PUSH The Cortina d'Ampezzo location will be inside the Faloria Mountain Club, situated at an altitude of 2,123 meters, while the outlet in Madonna di Campiglio will be in the Piana di Nambino area at an elevation of 1,700 meters, The Guardian reported. Along with Milan, Cortina d'Ampezzo co-hosted the 2026 Winter Olympics. KFC has partnered with Super G, the company behind the après-ski bars at several Italian resorts, to launch the two new restaurants. WHY KFC STOPPED CALLING ITSELF KENTUCKY FRIED CHICKEN — AND THE MYTHS THAT STILL WON'T DIE Reactions have been largely negative. "KFC should stay where it belongs! Not in our nature!" one person wrote on Instagram, expressing disdain that the restaurants would be within a UNESCO World Heritage site. "In almost the entire Alpine region, it's now impossible to fly drones because they disturb the wildlife, and if I post my content on social media I attract inadequate and disrespectful people to the mountains," content creator Matteo Peroni said in a YouTube video. "Does the smell of fried chicken not disrupt the wildlife and the balance that exists in the mountains? And doesn't a place like that bring inadequate people to the mountains?" he asked. CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE NEWS In a statement to Fox News Digital, KFC said it "is proud to serve communities around the world and, wherever we operate, we work to be a respectful and responsible part of the community." "We recognize the importance of the traditions and culture in Cortina d'Ampezzo, Madonna di Campiglio and the region," the statement said. "We are collaborating with local partners to deliver the experience our customers expect, while respecting the character of the location." The KFC outlets could prove to be convenient and affordable slope-side dining options, and many restaurants on or around ski runs already use self-service lines to serve more guests quickly, according to Italian news outlet Corriere della Sera. "This horror would weirdly improve the food situation in Madonna," one Instagram user wrote. TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ Overall, buckets of fried chicken and mashed potatoes don't seem to be eagerly anticipated in areas known for traditional dishes like regional pastas, dumplings, meats and cheeses influenced by Germany and Austria. "This most northern region of Italy, which is home to Cortina d’Ampezzo and Madonna di Campiglio, has sparred its way into its own existence and identity for thousands of years and in the process has taken and borrowed its cultural and culinary influences from its conquerors and its steady habits," Colin Caplan, a food historian based in New Haven, Connecticut, told Fox News Digital. It's not an impossible feat for fast-food chains to survive on the slopes. McDonald's has operated its McSki outlet, complete with the world's only "ski-thru" window, in Sälen, Sweden, since 1996. If they want to have the option of enjoying a KFC, they can visit a place that is already watered down with global commercial influence."

articles.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones says US move humbled her before big break with Steven Spielberg
articles.summary: The Swansea-born star got her big break in The Mask of Zorro which cemented her place as an A-lister.
articles.body:
Catherine Zeta-Jones has said she had an ego check after moving to America in the 1990s.

The Swansea-born star had become a household name in the UK, but Hollywood quickly provided a reality check for the rising star and she was even asked by casting agents if she had any acting experience.

It was during her stint on CBS mini-series Titanic that she was seen by Steven Spielberg who suggested she go for a role in The Mask of Zorro which he was producing.

"Five days later I got the job, and three days after that, I was down there starting my sword-fighting lessons," she said.

Zeta-Jones had become a star in the UK thanks to her breakout role in The Darling Buds of May that originally aired from 1991 to 1993.

But when she touched down in California, she was no longer recognised by the public and had a six-month visa to "give America a shot".

But Zeta-Jones told Business Insider it was "good" for her to have her ego knocked down a bit.

It was only when the Spielberg saw the Titanic series that she was given a major opportunity.

"I was shipped down to Mexico to screen test with Antonio Banderas," she said.

She credits it as her breakthrough into A-list territory and it was rumoured that she beat actors such as Salma Hayek and Jennifer Lopez to the part.

Zeta-Jones went on to work with Sean Connery in Entrapment which cemented her stardom, and she refers to the late James Bond actor as a "dear force of nature".

"I just never wanted to stop acting with him, because we were such good buddies," she said.

"He was so incredibly protective of me, like a daughter he never had, and he said that to me."

Zeta-Jones is currently starring in Kill Jackie, a revenge thriller based on the 2018 novel The Price You Pay by Nick Harkaway.

She stars as the titular Jackie Price, a Welsh high-end art dealer with a shady past in the drug trade who discovers a hit has been put out on her.

In September, Zeta-Jones made headlines for revealing that it was the first time she had used her Swansea accent for a role.

After decades of working on accents including English, American and Scottish she said the opportunity to speak in her native accent was both "liberating and cathartic".

As well as returning to her Welsh roots, the series' ultra-violent scenes have been a blast for Zeta-Jones, who relished the chance to go off the rails.

"I wanted the audience to come along on this ride with me and root for her. In all the craziness."

articles.title: Eisenkot slams Netanyahu’s ‘racist’ campaign against Palestinian Israelis
articles.summary: Prime ministerial hopeful calls attempts to marginalise and smear Palestinian citizens of Israel ‘an anti-state act’.
articles.body:
Israeli prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot has accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of fuelling a “racist and violent” campaign against Palestinian citizens of Israel during the elections.

Eisenkot, who has been tasked with forming Israel’s new government , posted a lengthy social media update on recent developments in Israel on Friday.

“Arab citizens of Israel make up 21 percent of the total population. Since the start of the election campaign, they have faced a racist and violent campaign of delegitimisation fuelled by the outgoing prime minister and his circle for political reasons,” Eisenkot wrote on X.

“The prime minister of Israel is the prime minister of all citizens, including those who did not vote for him,” he said. “Arab citizens of Israel are part of the Israeli story. The attempt to marginalise them and smear them as a group is an anti-state act.”

In Israel’s October 27 elections , Eisenkot’s four-party alliance won 48 seats, while Netanyahu’s right-wing and religious bloc secured 53, leaving both short of the 61 needed for a parliamentary majority. Arab-led parties, representing Palestinian citizens of Israel, won a record 19 seats.

Netanyahu repeatedly made unproven allegations of electoral fraud by Arab-majority parties – claims Israel’s own electoral authorities have rejected.

The caretaker leader has also repeatedly criticised Arab-led parties for refusing to describe Hamas as a “terror group” following the attack on Israel on October 7, 2023, despite all of the parties’ leaders condemning the Hamas-led assault.

“One can disagree with the representatives of the Arab parties, and one can even feel deep revulsion toward some of them, but one cannot, should not, and I will not allow an entire sector to be slandered,” Eisenkot said.

Arab-led parties have endorsed Eisenkot to replace Netanyahu. However, Eisenkot has ruled out forming a government with those parties, which would give him a 67-seat bloc. Winning the backing of the two ultra-Orthodox parties, United Torah Judaism and Shas, would give him exactly 61 seats.

On efforts to form an emergency government, Eisenkot reiterated that he wants to fulfil the mandate as soon as possible, adding “it would be a grave mistake not to do so”.

Netanyahu weighs renewed strikes on Iran

Eisenkot, who ran as Netanyahu’s main rival, has six weeks to form a new government.

While Netanyahu may be politically weakened, the prime minister is reported to be weighing military action against Iran , despite a lack of enthusiasm from the United States, his own military establishment, and Eisenkot, who has demanded that Netanyahu avoid any new escalation unless it is critical.

In Friday’s update, Eisenkot said he had met with Netanyahu and his military secretary on Thursday to discuss the security situation but provided no details.

Earlier in the week, Eisenkot said that he was open to including Netanyahu in his coalition. Eisenkot suggested Netanyahu’s far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich was also welcome to join.

Eisenkot led Israel’s military from 2015 to 2019 and sat as an observer in Netanyahu’s war cabinet for the first eight months of Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, which began in October 2023.
